appStore.name: Gravita: Skills & Strength
appStore.subtitle: Calisthenics at your pace
appStore.promotionalText: Build your bodyweight practice from setup to independent sessions, with pushing, pulling, legs, core, progression options and a visible lesson path.

playStore.shortDescription: Build bodyweight practice with progressive lessons and a local progress path.

description:
Gravita teaches strength and skill fundamentals in five skill areas with 117 original English and Turkish written lessons in 7 courses: bodyweight training, dumbbell and kettlebell fundamentals, barbell fundamentals, low-ring support and pulling, and hand-support balance.

The main course offers 56 original English and Turkish calisthenics lessons across 10 modules: preparation, bodyweight squats and hinges, progressive pushing and pulling, core control, balance and session planning. The dumbbell and kettlebell paths cover a written route, handling and transitions. Three 12-lesson foundation courses introduce a light technique bar, low rings close to standing and supported hand balance. Equipment-dependent tasks explain setup and alternatives. Advanced skill lessons explain prerequisites and supervision rather than requiring risky attempts. No inversion instruction is included.

Free lessons and subscription: the first part of every course is free, 44 of 117 lessons in total (about the first third of each course). A Gravita subscription, or Motion+ which also covers the other Motion apps, includes the remaining lessons and independent practice: creating the eight-week program and logging new sessions. Your progress, saved program and history always stay readable. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your App Store or Google Play account settings; the price and any free trial are shown before you buy. Purchases need a Motion account so access can be restored on another device.

You can browse without signing in and use an optional shared Motion account. The account uses your email address, account ID and optional display name; account deletion is available in the app and does not cancel a store subscription. Course records stay on the device within the current guest or account scope.

Course progress is your own practice record; no lesson completion certifies mastery. Demonstration video is not included in this version. The physical tasks of the barbell, rings and hand-support courses await expert review, permitted demonstrations and learner observation; reading progress does not validate movement. Camera coaching and exercise form grades are not available in this version. General adaptations do not determine personal health suitability.

'Graded'/'scored'/'coach' gibi asiri-vaat kelimeleri KULLANILMADI (G-213'un kapattigi tam o sinif).
$whatItDoesWhy: lib/app/onboarding_strings.dart OnboardingStrings.valueWhatWeDo (G-213, bir kez yalan soyleyip duzeltilmis, bugun dogrulugu olculu): 'Your phone camera counts your reps, on-device, and only counts one when it can see you are really doing the movement. $whatItDoesntWhy: AYNI dosya, OnboardingStrings.valueWhatWeDont: 'Not medical. Not a substitute for a coach. We cannot stop you from falling.' Birebir.

Sayilar bugun olculdu (python3 -c "json.load(open('content/library.json'))", 2026-08-16): 31 toplam, canli yalniz bodyweight_squat + push_up (ikisinin de derived precondition kapisi var — squat: hip-diz Pearson korelasyonu, push_up: torso_angle_from_vertical, M-F-38-PILOT-RAPORU.md). ✅ H-58 (orkestratör, 2026-08-16): bu not yalniz DUZYAZIYDI, sifir okuyucusu vardi — artik tools/validate_store_listing.py run_all_gates.sh'in SUIT 3'unde bu sayilari content/library.json'in GERCEK sayimina karsi sinar (bu dosya + STORE-LISTING-TASLAK.md'nin ikisi de), hasat turu ilerleyip metin guncellenmezse KIRMIZI yanar. Bayatlama artik SESSIZ olamaz.
$privacyClaimWhy: Kamera ve video iddialari yerel isleme akisina dayanir. Ortak Motion hesabi e-posta, istege bagli ad ve kullanici kimligini Auth/profil/uyelik icin isler; kamera verisi ve yerel seans ozeti yuklenmez. Provider ve magaza veri beyanlari yayin oncesi dogrulanir.
$notClaimed: No independent skill/mastery outcome, physical-phone performance, clinical suitability, camera form grade or approved AI demonstration is asserted. This local content-preparation draft has not been uploaded.
$openingClosingReframeWhy: H-85 (kurucu, 2026-08-17): appStore/name 'Gravita: Rep Counter'dan ASC'deki canli ada ('Gravita: Skills & Strength') cekildi (orkestrator yazdi, mekanik kalem). Ama description'in acilis/kapanis cumleleri hala salt 'rep counter' kimligi anlatiyordu ⇒ baslik ile govde CELISIYORDU (baslik genis vaat ediyor, govde dar taniniyordu). Bu bir hat-yargisi kalemiydi (orkestrator metni yazmadi, 'senin' dedi). DUZELTME, YALNIZ iki cumle: acilis 'Gravita counts your reps...' -> 'Gravita is a skills-and-strength practice app, built around one honest rule: ...' ve kapanis 'a movement-practice tool' -> 'a skills-and-strength practice tool'. URUNU GENISLETMEDI: hicbir yeni yetenek/vaat eklenmedi (coach/plan/program kelimeleri hala yok), 'HONEST ABOUT WHAT'S READY' paragrafi (31 toplam / 2 canli, tools/validate_store_listing.py'nin GERCEK kapisi) BIREBIR AYNI birakildi — degisen yalniz KIMLIK cercevesi, KAPSAM iddiasi degil. 'squats, pushes, pulls, core' zaten mevcut govdede vardi (31-hareket paragrafi), yalniz acilista da GORUNUR kilindi.

cameraPermissionRationale.ios: Gravita uses the camera to count complete reps and measure tempo. Video is processed on this device and is not uploaded or saved; movement, rep count and session duration are saved locally.
cameraPermissionRationale.$source: Kaynak: ios/Runner/Info.plist NSCameraUsageDescription ve en.lproj/InfoPlist.strings; 2026-09-24 TR çevirisi tr.lproj/InfoPlist.strings ile listing.tr-TR.json içinde eşleştirildi. Hareket adı verilmez; tam tekrar, tempo, cihazda işlenen video ve yerel seans özeti anlatılır.
